title: Router 75%/150% and residential 600% strain pins have no direct test coverage
location: core/warnings_test.odin:83 (host-only ladder pins); demos/lose.dem + demos/warn.dem (residential level only, via golden)
evidence: spec-4-1-warning-forecast.md Design Notes: "Router (40 u/s): amber at 1 waiting packet (75 %), red at 2 (150 %); content_host (80): amber at 2, red at 3; residential: red at any waiting packet (600 %) — honest: a stuck house IS critical." / core/warnings_test.odin:83 "// fails). Host throughput 80: 1 packet = 37 % (healthy), 2 = 75 % (amber), 3 = 112 % (red). The relief draw opens host->router->res and drains all." — the only strain-math pins asserted in the suite are the host ladder + the pipe bound; no test places a stuck packet on a router (throughput 40) or asserts the residential 600 % figure (lose.dem/warn.dem pin the red LEVEL via golden T1/T2, never the 600 % value).
detail: P0-listed strain math pins: the router case has zero coverage anywhere (no unit test, no demo strains a router backlog); the residential 600 % value is unasserted. Same shared strain_level code path as the pinned host/pipe cases, so risk is low, but the documented pins are unverified.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test: 1 stuck packet on a router (30/40 = 75 % amber) and 2 (60/40 = 150 % red), plus 1 waiting packet on a residential (30/5 = 600 % red), asserting levels + exact event ticks.

title: Node Red→Amber easing branch (CLEARED Node_Critical while strained persists) has no direct test
detail: One-event-per-transition matrix pinned 5/6; the node easing branch (the cleared sign naming the level that ENDED, with strained persisting) is the uncovered sixth. P3 — the pipe twin pins the identical contract shape.
recommended_fix: Extend test_node_strain_amber_red_clear with a partial-relief step (3 stuck → 2 stuck): assert CLEARED Node_Critical at that tick while Node_Strained remains.

title: Exact ladder boundaries (69/70/89/90/91) never exercised — inclusive lower bounds pinned only at closest reachable percents
detail: P3 boundary gap: the inclusive ladder is pinned at 75/112 (host) and 83/100/67 (pipe), never at the exact 70/90 cutoffs; a shift of the boundary by one (e.g. > instead of >=) would go undetected.
recommended_fix: Unit-test strain_level() directly with crafted pct values 69/70/89/90/91 to pin the inclusive-lower-bound semantics independent of reachable unit combinations.

title: Pipe-pressure replication to member pipes of a shared bundle is untested
evidence: core/warnings.odin:212 "// --- 4. pipe levels (each pipe carries its bundle's pressure) + events" and :218 "bs := state.bundles.pipe_bundle[ps]" / core/bundles_test.odin:44-46 "// THE headline AC (Story 2.1): parallel pipes between a pair bundle into\n\t// one pooled link whose capacity is the SUM of members (rule 3, static at\n\t// table-build). 2 standard (cap 15 each) -> 30; 3 standard -> 45." — bundles are keyed by node pair (bundles.odin bundles_slot_for_pair), so parallel pipes share one bundle; every warnings_test fixture and every demo uses distinct node pairs, so no test or golden ever asserts two member pipes carrying the same pressure level.
detail: P3 gap: the replication derivation (press[bs] applied to each member pipe slot) is a two-line loop; bundles_test pins the 2.1 capacity view but never steps warning_evaluate on a multi-pipe bundle.
recommended_fix: Add a parallel-pipe fixture (2 pipes on one pair) with a lane at bound and assert both member pipe slots read the same level and share the transition events.

title: Dead-node-slot never-warns path and demolished-node resident packets untested
detail: P3 gap: a demolished node that was Red must read None with NO phantom Warning_Cleared event (the branch comment's own contract), and its resident packets' waiting_ticks must clear on E29 drop-back (flow.odin:753) — neither is asserted by any test.
recommended_fix: Demolish a Red node mid-strain: assert the slot reads None, no phantom Warning_Cleared is emitted, and the resident packets' waiting_ticks reset on drop-back.

title: Tag-conditional event byte-layout (pre-4.1 event bytes) has no regression pin — goldens cannot catch it
detail: P3 gap: pre-4.1 event byte-identity rests on code review of serialize.odin alone; a tag-conditional regression would pass 97/97 tests and 9/9 demos. The E10 replay pin only proves self-consistency, not the pre-4.1 byte layout.
recommended_fix: Unit-test state_writer output for a tag-3 (SLA_THRESHOLD_CROSSED) and a drop event: assert the serialized payload contains no sign/target bytes, pinning the pre-4.1 layout.
